preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 1 and 216, inclusive.
The degree of each vertex is between 0 and n - 1, inclusive.
The XOR sum of adjacent vertices for each vertex is less than 216.

postconditions.description: The number of edges printed is equal to the number of edges in the initial graph.

postconditions.expression: all((0 <= a < n and 0 <= b < n and a != b) for a, b in edges)
postconditions.description: Each edge is between two distinct vertices within the range of 0 to n - 1.

postconditions.expression: all(degreei == sum(1 for b in range(n) if (a, b) in edges or (b, a) in edges) for a, degreei in enumerate(degrees))
postconditions.description: The degree of each vertex matches the number of edges connected to it.

postconditions.expression: all(si == sum(s for b, s in enumerate(degrees) if (a, b) in edges or (b, a) in edges) for a, si in enumerate(xors))
postconditions.description: The XOR sum of adjacent vertices for each vertex matches the sum of the XOR sums of the edges connected to it.
